critical_code_review_comments: Auth split (require_user vs require_device) is correctly enforced: device keys rejected on user routes and JWTs rejected on device routes with 401 both ways. WWW-Authenticate: Bearer challenge present on all protected user endpoints.
Event contract uses extra='forbid' with tracking_session_id as Optional (v1 backward compatible) — confirmed both event shapes (with and without) accepted in the same batch.
Heartbeat is correctly isolated from visitor counting: enter_count/exit_count unchanged after ok/source_down heartbeats, and last_event_at not overwritten.
Frontend clears pc.session.v1 on 401 as designed (tampered token test navigated back to /login within seconds).
Prior iteration_5 note about date-prev/next chevron touch target (36px vs 44px) still applies in Toolbar.tsx; not re-tested in this pass but worth fixing.
